processes:task-ge-operate-transform-6hht.plain_language_description: With the certificate in hand, the processing custodian executes the operating for the reporting: the audit findings, recommendations, and follow-up actions are written down for the body that owns them, and the outcomes pack is produced for confirmation.
processes:task-ge-operate-transform-6hht.business_purpose: It exists because a finding that never reaches its owning body is a finding that will happen again - the writing-down is what delivers it.

processes:task-ge-operate-verify-7fq4qq.plain_language_name: Hold the Pack Against the Contracts Before the Findings Go

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the risk function reads the pack against the cycle's contract and the assurance standards, naming whatever deviates and how it will be mended.

The reviews' execution stays provable for as long as the governance demands.
processes:task-ge-operate-record-28uxcx.business_purpose: It exists so the reviews' execution can be evidenced for as long as the governance demands.
processes:task-ge-operate-record-28uxcx.practical_context: It opens once the completion confirmation is issued and the case file may be retained, and it closes with the case file held under the retention schedule, its integrity protected.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian lays the case down under the schedule that keeps it and sets the retrieval handles an oversight review would consult.

processes:task-ge-operate-confirm-v6wutc.plain_language_name: Reconcile the Pack and Confirm the Reviews
processes:task-ge-operate-confirm-v6wutc.plain_language_description: When the outcomes pack exists, the confirmation custodian sets it beside the cycle's contract and the evidence standards for assurance, reconciles the two, and issues the operating confirmation to the custodian of governance and the board secretary, logging it into the case file.
processes:task-ge-operate-confirm-v6wutc.business_purpose: It exists because reviews nobody has confirmed are reviews nobody can surface risk from.
processes:task-ge-operate-confirm-v6wutc.practical_context: It opens once the artefact is produced and the reconciliation may run against the governing contract, and it closes with the completion confirmation issued and acknowledged, custody passed to the records custodian.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian sets the pack beside the cycle's contract and the assurance standards and issues the operating confirmation to the custodian of governance and the board secretary.

processes:task-ge-operate-intake-vc6me8.plain_language_name: Take Custody of the Reviews Input Pack
processes:task-ge-operate-intake-vc6me8.plain_language_description: The intake custodian takes charge of the operating pack — the board and committee cycles, the assurance-evidence queue, the risk-review calendar, and the audit plan — and writes the manifest that ties the pack into the case file for the operating.
processes:task-ge-operate-intake-vc6me8.business_purpose: It exists so the reviews begin from a registered pack rather than from loose papers.
processes:task-ge-operate-intake-vc6me8.practical_context: It opens when custody of the pack arrives and the intake contract applies, and it closes with the manifest registered and bound to the case file, custody passed onward to the verification custodian.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the risk function takes charge of the cycles, queue, calendar, and plan, and writes the binding manifest.

processes:task-ge-operate-transform-6h87.plain_language_name: Run the Reviews the Cycle Boundary Brings Due
processes:task-ge-operate-transform-6h87.plain_language_description: With the certificate in hand, the processing custodian executes the operating for the reviews: the risk reviews due at the cycle boundary are executed against the registers and the scales, and the outcomes pack is produced for confirmation.
processes:task-ge-operate-transform-6h87.business_purpose: It exists because a review overdue is a register going stale - the execution is what keeps the risk picture fresh at each boundary.
processes:task-ge-operate-transform-6h87.practical_context: It opens once the verification certificate is in hand and the bounded operating may be executed, and it closes with the artefact produced and custody passed onward to the confirmation custodian.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the risk function runs the reviews due at the boundary against the registers and the scales.

processes:task-ge-operate-verify-6hwk5e.plain_language_name: Hold the Reviews Against the Contracts Before They Execute
processes:task-ge-operate-verify-6hwk5e.plain_language_description: With the manifest registered, the verification custodian reads the whole pack against the cycle's contract, the evidence standards for assurance, and the review methodology for risk, and issues the report naming whatever deviates and how it will be mended.
processes:task-ge-operate-verify-6hwk5e.business_purpose: It exists because reviews executed short of the contracts would measure against the wrong scales from day one - the reading is what keeps them honest.
processes:task-ge-operate-verify-6hwk5e.practical_context: It opens once the manifest is registered and the contract and quality checks may run against the pack, and it closes with the verification certificate issued, custody passed onward to the processing custodian.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the risk function reads the pack against the cycle's contract and the assurance standards, naming whatever deviates and how it will be mended.
